# Batterly — Design Notes

Source: ColorLib "Cake" (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/cake/)
Preview: https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/cake/
New name: batterly (ColorLib "Cake" → Batterly)

## Section order (top to bottom)

1. Header (top bar + main nav)
2. Hero Slider
3. About (text + progress bars)
4. Categories (icon carousel)
5. Product Grid (4x2 cards)
6. Class Registration (form + video)
7. Team Grid (4 cards)
8. Testimonial Carousel
9. Instagram Photo Grid
10. Map / Contact
11. Footer (3-col + copyright bar)
